name: per-character-rise
title: Per Character Rise
description: Letters slide up from below with crisp, deliberate kinetic timing.

variables.label: Origin
variables.description: Which side of the line the letters travel from. above is the shipped motion, below mirrors it.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: Scales the travel offset, so the letters cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Type size, which also sets how tall the clipping window is.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Letter colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.
